basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer based in Boston, MA. I've been a gamer since I was a kid, with a particular love for survival and strategy games. Outside of gaming, I'm passionate about photography and often spend weekends exploring nature trails. I'm currently single, and when I'm not coding or gaming, I volunteer at a local animal shelter. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and late at night due to my work schedule and nocturnal habits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My interest in survival games like Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead led me to dive deep into game mechanics and modding. I often self-teach through online tutorials and community forums.
